### Fixed

- *(workflow)* Accept the CRD's camelCase step fields in the API in [#1376](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1376) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(reconciler)* Retry informer setup instead of skipping a type in [#1379](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1379) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(reconciler)* Reconcile one MCPServer on one worker at a time in [#1380](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1380) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(aggregator)* Retry soon a 401 on a just-issued forwarded token in [#1381](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1381) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
